name: Banish Rodent Deterrent

features.text: Developed to prevent rodent entry, nesting, and foraging.

description: Formulated with essential oils that deliver a smell and taste developed to deter mice, rats, and other rodents from burrowing into a vehicle’s engine compartment and undercarriage. The heat of a recently used vehicle can last up to 24 hours, making it an inviting place for various rodents to seek warmth and begin nesting.
application: Refer to directions for use supplied by your MOC® representative and/or at following web address https://mocproducts.com/mm/pdf/Instructions-Banish-Application.pdf
review: Bottle photo is only 573 px tall

ad.headline: Rodent Deterrent
ad.description: Formulated with essential oils that deliver a smell and taste developed to deter mice, rats, and other rodents from burrowing into a vehicle’s engine compartment and undercarriage. The heat of a recently used vehicle can last up to 24 hours, making it an inviting place for various rodents to seek warmth and begin nesting. By applying BANISH to these areas, a barrier is created to help keep away rodents and their offspring.
benefits: Developed to prevent rodent entry, nesting, and foraging.
review: Ad headline set by hand from the old artwork
